STUDIO SLATE - ACTIVE PROJECTS
Page 1
THE LANTERN KEEPER
(fka Lighthouse Song)
Studio: Northlight Pictures
Genre: Drama/Thriller
Location: Los Angeles, CA
Start Date: Spring 2026
Status: Actively Casting
Synopsis: A retired lighthouse keeper discovers coded messages in the logbooks left by her late father and is
pulled into a decades-old smuggling case.
Roles:
- MARGARET HALE [Lead]
Female, 60s, any ethnicity. Sharp, guarded, funny.
- DETECTIVE OWEN PRICE [Supporting]
Male, 40s. Patient, quietly ambitious.
- YOUNG MARGARET [Small]
Female, 20s. Flashback scenes only.
Paper Crowns
Studio: Bluecastle Studios
Genre: Dramedy
Location: LA
Start Date: 2/1/2026
Status: In Development
Synopsis: Three siblings inherit a failing costume shop and one summer to save it.
Roles:
- JUNE OKAFOR [Lead]
Female, 30s, open ethnicity. The responsible one.
- THEO OKAFOR [Supporting Lead]
Male, late 20s. Charming, unreliable.
